name: Azeroth Companion
title: Acquisition & Specialization Intelligence
features: Added Acquisition Intelligence to Loot Hunter, cross-referencing manually saved farming goals with the existing limited historical acquisition references, including documented source links and steps where available.
Added filtering by curated reference coverage, manual farming completion, and personal goal searches, with logged attempt summaries and clear labels for undocumented acquisition sources.
Added Specialization Intelligence inside Talent Forge for official talent node IDs, categories, available source descriptions, spell and talent IDs, and manual planned-rank review.
Research panels are read-only: no new account privileges, no changes to gear goals or talent allocations, and no fictional drop rates, best-in-slot advice or in-game ownership verification.
Preserves the existing v7.8 Warcraft Research Board, v7.7.2 music controls, Founder avatar and saved data. Full live player testing remains pending.
